description: W.A. Nandana Athuda v. Sarath Moregoda and Others W.A. Nandana Athuda v. Sarath Moregoda and Others View More before Hon. Eric Basnayake, J.
parties: W.A. Nandana Athuda v. Sarath Moregoda and Others W.A. Nandana Athuda v. Sarath Moregoda and Others View More
keywords: The Petitioner sought relief under Section 765 of the Civil Procedure Code to admit an out-of-time appeal and set aside orders dismissing her intervention claim in a partition action. She contended that she had not been notified of subsequent proceedings or the judgment. Held - Application dismissed because the record showed she had revoked her previous proxy, appointed new attorneys, and was represented when judgement was fixed, and thus, failed to prove circumstances beyond her control.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Civil Procedure Code
